geometry.interpretation_limit: The very large nominal separation, unknown mutual node, circular-orbit approximation and propagated ephemeris uncertainty make this a weak conjunction case and only an approximate ranking diagnostic.
geometry.model: circular edge-on orbits, common sky-plane nodal line, MJD treated as BJD for archive ranking

target.selection_reason: LS4A found four complete public GBT filterbank ABACAD cadences. The frozen frequency-first rule selected X band because its 10.014 GHz centre is closest to the paper-motivated 10 GHz archive-ranking anchor.
